projects.name: RY
details: Modules: CSM & ITSM
Implementation and Enhancing ITSM and CSM modules
• Implementation and activation of OOTB Now Assist Skills for CSM and ITSM modules.
• Implemented Case, Account and Contact Management for B2B Model.
• Implemented Omni-channel to customer engagement via Live Agent Chat, SMS, Web
and Email.
• Contributed to ServiceNow platform architecture and roadmap initiatives,
translating business requirements into scalable enterprise solutions and supporting
platform enhancements across ITSM and CSM.
• Designed and implemented enterprise-level ServiceNow integrations, including bi- directional integrations with LogicMonitor and SAP CRM using REST APIs, Import Sets,
Transform Maps, Script Includes, OAuth 2.0, and event-driven architecture.
• Implementation of Inbound Email Flow to create Case, Incident and Generic Service
Request Submission via Email.
• ServiceNow development experience across ITSM and CSM, with expertise in Business
Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Script Includes, JavaScript/Glide, Flow

entry.text: Overview: External system integrations to improve operational efficiency and cross-platform
visibility.
Responsibilities:
• Designed and implemented integration between ServiceNow Incident module and SAP CRM
for automated Case creation.
• Developed custom UI Action “Create SAP Case” to trigger case creation from Incident form.
• Implemented event-driven architecture using Event Registry and Script Actions.

system traceability.
• Eliminated manual SAP case creation effort and improved process efficiency.

system traceability.
